chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: Stars who appeared on the Meroff stage
summary: Famous comedians and film stars make personal appearances with the show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: stuff, but - uh - it was--- well, I thought I was in heaven. To meet all the great stars and work with the great stars and I remember---
Just name anybody and they played there--- everybody famous in the show business was there---
George Burns came along - didn't he?
Oh, God - all those guys -- even the guys that were on big radio shows would appear with us, you know and---
Well, that's the way it always has been -- or was - in Chicago---

Yeah - all the great comedians and all the great movie stars would appear on our stage anytime to appear with their picture - you know - to help advertise the picture - you know - a personal appearance. You know, maybe they'd sing a little song or do something.
